turns.assessment: The simultaneous ~64–65 ps DGD increase and pre-FEC BER rise across many independent lightpaths strongly indicate a common fibre PMD event (DGD_RISE), not a client, transponder, amplifier, or power-loss fault. Unchanged optical power, OSNR, and amplifier telemetry argue against cuts, connector faults, span loss, and amplifier failures. The endpoint measurements do not localize the added DGD to one of the ten directional fibre spans on the shared S18–S19 route; aerial spans are somewhat more likely, but no individual element reaches the 80% commitment threshold.
